about_the_game:
Here's the polished English translation for the game description:The Six Lines Chapter (Demo)，Featuring the Official Version's Prologue & First Full Chapter, plus Partial Chapters from Book II.About the Background

"Every face of all living beings hides beneath the divination; the mystery of fate lies in the human heart."
Our game adopts a first-person perspective, allowing players to immersive themselves in the role of a street fortune-teller.
In the game, players will experience multi-dimensional exploration and analysis of the plot through practices like hexagram deduction, reading people's expressions and moods, and logical reasoning.

About the Plot

Each client carries unique emotional traits and folk customs.
Players' "deduction" of hexagrams and "choices" regarding matters and human nature will determine the different directions the story takes.

About the Gameplay

We have designed and integrated the "hexagram casting – hexagram arranging – hexagram interpreting" process of Six Yao into the game's props and gameplay.
Through the game's settings, players can easily understand and learn the entry-level knowledge of Six Yao.
The game also hides puzzle-solving elements such as "reading people's expressions" and "logical reasoning". The alternation of these two gameplay tracks enhances playability, making the fun level UP! UP!!

About the Demo Main Plot

Dear stallholders (a friendly term for players), you will start with the Prologue to easily grasp the core of hexagram interpretation: "understanding the reason".
From Chapter 2, you will officially dive into the core Six Yao gameplay, experience the first branch choice, and deduce different endings.
Dear stallholders, no need to worry about the threshold of Six Yao. Step into our game world, and you will immersive yourself in the charm of Six Yao step by step.

Welcome to Join Us

If you are:

  • A player interested in traditional Chinese culture but don't know where to start;

  • An experience-seeker who loves text-based storytelling and psychological puzzle-solving styles;

  • Someone willing to feel the warmth of human nature and the weight of fate in a game;

Then, The Divination Holds A Thousand Faces: The Six Yao Volume will welcome you for the first time in its demo.
We hope every stallholder can step into the unique world of being a fortune-teller easily, just like flipping through an old book or listening to a street story.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS 或同等版本
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 或同等性能
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X（支持Vulkan）
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA兼容声卡
  • VR Support: 不支持VR
  • Additional Notes: 需要支持Vulkan的显卡驱动程序
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 或更高版本
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 或更高
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB（支持Vulkan）
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA兼容声卡
  • VR Support: 不支持VR
  • Additional Notes: 推荐使用最新的显卡驱动程序以获得最佳性能

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: 指定 Apple 芯片、Intel 或兼容都包括，例如："Apple M1 或英特尔酷睿 i5 第8代处理器"
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 集成显卡或独立显卡均可
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 兼容macOS的声卡
  • Additional Notes: 支持 Retina 显示器。如果您使用的是基于英特尔的Mac，并且无法通过 Rosetta 在 Apple 芯片上运行好，请输入'仅限英特尔'。
